messages:
Ava L: heads up / converting contractor Dana R to 0.6 FTE perm. Proposed FTE comp $140k -> prorated $84k; S2 top prorated is $81k so ~3k over. Start target 2026-07-06. What's the approval flow?

Marco D: candidate verbal accepted. No relocation. Role level IC2. Manager justification ready.

Priya - People Ops: Routing: please include manager justification, org code, and whether candidate expects benefits pro-rata. Any >$2k prorate exception goes to comp committee. I'll open ticket once you paste justification.

Ava L: Manager justification: "Key product ownership for onboarding flow; reduces contractor churn; retains institutional knowledge." Org code ENG-PLAT, candidate expects pro-rated medical and PTO.

Comp Chair: We'll review on Thurs. If committee approves, comp team will either approve exception or propose equity-top up. Which does candidate prefer?

Marco D: Candidate prefers base over equity. Equity-topup is last resort.

Payroll Bot: Note payroll cutoff for July hire is 2026-06-20 for retro pay to start date. If ticket not approved by then, earliest payroll start will be 2026-08-01.

Priya - People Ops: Thanks — creating HR ticket HR-2991112223, routing to finance, comp committee, legal, and benefits. Reply here with `+approve` or `-need info`.
